Job Description
Job Title : AI Engineer / Gen AI Engineer or developer /Python Gen AI engineer / AI/ML Engineer

Relevant Experience : 4 to 12yrs

Required technical skill: LangChain and/or LangGraph, Python, AWS

Design, develop, and support cloud-native automation and AI agent workflows using Python, RPA, and LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain / LangGraph), deployed on AWS using containerized architectures.

Build AI agents using LangChain and LangGraph to orchestrate tools, APIs, and workflows.

Integrate automation with enterprise systems via REST APIs and databases.

Deploy and operate solutions on AWS (IAM, S3, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, CloudWatch).

Collaborate with onshore architects and follow defined architecture standards.



Location : Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune, Bangalore, Kolkata

CTC Range : 10 to 30lpa
